name: Azure Retail Prices
summary: Keyless Microsoft retail (pay-as-you-go, reservation, savings plan) prices for every Azure service, SKU and region.
notes: Keyless. Up to 1,000 records per response; follow NextPageLink (it carries $skip) until it is null.
Filter values are case-sensitive from api-version 2023-01-01-preview: serviceName eq 'Virtual Machines' works, 'virtual machines' does not.
USD prices are Microsoft's retail prices; other currencies are for reference only.
Savings-plan prices appear only with api-version=2023-01-01-preview.

endpoints.name: List retail prices
endpoints.summary: Price records (retailPrice, unitOfMeasure, armSkuName, region, type) matching an OData filter.

filter.description: OData filter on armRegionName, Location, meterId, meterName, productid, skuId, productName, skuName, serviceName, serviceId, serviceFamily, priceType or armSkuName.
filter.example: serviceName eq 'Virtual Machines' and armRegionName eq 'westeurope'

meterRegion.description: 'primary' to return only primary meter prices (api-version 2021-10-01 and later).

skip.description: Records to skip, as used in NextPageLink.
